messages:
maria: FYI we received model artifacts from OpenCollab partner. S3: s3://redwood-artifacts/inbound/open-collab/ocm-2026-03/weights.pt  tokenizer: s3://redwood-artifacts/inbound/open-collab/ocm-2026-03/tokenizer.json  SHA256: a3f4b2c9e7f4b12d8c3f0e9a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9c1
cheng: Can you paste the exact checksum and who signed it?
maria: checksum (full): a3f4b2c9e7f4b12d8c3f0e9a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9c1. Signed-by: partner-key-2026 (attached signature blob in metadata.json).
priya: @cheng I'll take registry ingest. Quick checklist: verify checksum, verify signer via KMS, create model entry in registry, attach model-card, record provenance in ledger, tag versions, set retention policy. Anything missing?
sam: Don't forget to run a quick quantization smoke: q8 and q4 on ci-gpu02 with the small prompt set (quant-smoke.json). If outputs diverge too much, fallback to fp16. Also capture token-level diffs for the smoke set.
maria: added acceptance gates to metadata: eval_perplexity_v2 < 12, p50 latency < 120ms on dedicated T4, no >2% truncation/corruption errors. Also require model-card and license check.
cheng: I'll handle kms verification. Commands I ran: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/inbound/open-collab/ocm-2026-03/metadata.json - | jq .sha256
# verify local checksum against remote blob
sha256sum -c --status metadata.json
```
Looks good locally. artifact-bot: digital-sigil verification incoming. :eyes:
artifact-bot: checksum-match: true, signer-trusted: true, kv: {"signer":"partner-key-2026","verified_at":"2026-09-12T03:14:15Z"} :white_check_mark:
priya: Registry entry draft I will push to the UI and API: 
```
model_id: oc/ocm-2026-03
version: v0.1.0
storage:
  - s3://redwood-model-registry/oc/ocm-2026-03/v0.1.0/
provenance:
  source: open-collab
  signed_by: partner-key-2026
  sha256: a3f4b2c9e7f4b12d8c3f0e9a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9c1
license: permissive
notes: initial import, awaiting quant/bench
```
sam: For quant runs use this script: 
```
python tools/qbench.py --model s3://redwood-artifacts/inbound/open-collab/ocm-2026-03/weights.pt --tokenizer s3://redwood-artifacts/inbound/open-collab/ocm-2026-03/tokenizer.json --modes q4 q8 fp16 --tasks eval-set-v2 --out results/ocm-2026-03/
```
Include latency, ppl, token-diff metrics. Post results as a short table.
cheng: Note on KMS/HSM: we must store the signing-key fingerprint in audit and record time-of-verify and verifier id. I'll open infra ticket to ensure long-term retention of the verification event (will tag @infra-bot).
infra-bot: created infra ticket INFRA-9442 for verification-event retention and KMS fingerprint archival. ETA: 3 business days.
maria: Who's owning final acceptance + canary? @sam for quant/bench sign-off, @priya for registry + canary rollout?
priya: I'll own registry onboarding, model-card, and the canary route config for Dedicated. Will coordinate with @eng-platform for traffic rules.
sam: I'll own quant experiments and perf review. Will run q4/q8 over night and post results tomorrow morning. :coffee:
maria: thanks everyone. If canary causes any regressions, tag #eng-oncall and escalate. Closing loop here — will update metadata.json with signed verification and registry url when done.
